AWS_PROFILE=deploy-admin python3 -u - <<'PY' > push.txt 2>&1
import gzip, hashlib, io, json, tarfile, time, urllib.request
import boto3
REPO = "eyecloud-fargate-runner"
BASE_TAG = "mott-lane-35"
NEW_TAG = "mott-lane-36"
FILE_PATH = "opt/cvc-booking-gateway/bland_gateway.py"
FIXED = "/home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGWfix4/gw-correction-offer-relative/bland_gateway_fixed.py"
ecr = boto3.client("ecr", region_name="us-east-1")
resp = ecr.batch_get_image(repositoryName=REPO, imageIds=[{"imageTag": BASE_TAG}])
manifest = json.loads(resp["images"][0]["imageManifest"])
if "manifests" in manifest:
    entry = next(m for m in manifest["manifests"] if m.get("platform", {}).get("architecture") in ("amd64", "x86_64"))
    manifest = json.loads(ecr.batch_get_image(repositoryName=REPO, imageIds=[{"imageDigest": entry["digest"]}])["images"][0]["imageManifest"])
cfg_url = ecr.get_download_url_for_layer(repositoryName=REPO, layerDigest=manifest["config"]["digest"])["downloadUrl"]
config = json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(cfg_url, timeout=120).read())
body = open(FIXED, "rb").read()
buf = io.BytesIO()
tar = tarfile.open(fileobj=buf, mode="w")
info = tarfile.TarInfo(name=FILE_PATH)
info.size = len(body)
info.mode = 0o644
info.mtime = 0
tar.addfile(info, io.BytesIO(body))
tar.close()
raw_tar = buf.getvalue()
diff_id = "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(raw_tar).hexdigest()
gz = io.BytesIO()
with gzip.GzipFile(fileobj=gz, mode="wb", mtime=0) as g:
    g.write(raw_tar)
blob = gz.getvalue()
layer_digest = "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest()
config["rootfs"]["diff_ids"].append(diff_id)
config.setdefault("history", []).append({"created": "2026-08-04T00:00:00Z", "created_by": "mott-lane-36 negation/following fix (ringer fable-chief)", "comment": "single-file overlay of bland_gateway.py"})
cfg_bytes = json.dumps(config).encode()
cfg_digest = "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(cfg_bytes).hexdigest()

def upload(data, digest):
    up = ecr.initiate_layer_upload(repositoryName=REPO)
    ecr.upload_layer_part(repositoryName=REPO, uploadId=up["uploadId"], partFirstByte=0, partLastByte=len(data) - 1, layerPartBlob=data)
    ecr.complete_layer_upload(repositoryName=REPO, uploadId=up["uploadId"], layerDigests=[digest])
    print("UPLOADED %s bytes=%d" % (digest[:19], len(data)))

upload(blob, layer_digest)
upload(cfg_bytes, cfg_digest)
layer_media = manifest["layers"][-1]["mediaType"]
manifest["layers"].append({"mediaType": layer_media, "size": len(blob), "digest": layer_digest})
manifest["config"] = {"mediaType": manifest["config"]["mediaType"], "size": len(cfg_bytes), "digest": cfg_digest}
out = ecr.put_image(repositoryName=REPO, imageManifest=json.dumps(manifest), imageTag=NEW_TAG)
print("IMAGE_TAG=%s" % NEW_TAG)
print("PUSHED_DIGEST=%s" % out["image"]["imageId"]["imageDigest"])
print("LAYERS_NOW=%d" % len(manifest["layers"]))
print("PUSH_DONE")
PY
rc=$?; cat push.txt; exit $rc
tasks.check: grep -q 'PUSH_DONE' push.txt || { echo 'FAIL: push did not complete:'; tail -8 push.txt; exit 1; }; grep -q 'IMAGE_TAG=mott-lane-36' push.txt || { echo 'FAIL: no image tag line'; exit 1; }; AWS_PROFILE=deploy-admin aws ecr describe-images --repository-name eyecloud-fargate-runner --image-ids imageTag=mott-lane-36 --query 'imageDetails[0].imageDigest' --output text | grep -q sha256 || { echo 'FAIL: ECR does not report the new tag'; exit 1; }; echo "PASS: $(grep -m1 'PUSHED_DIGEST=' push.txt); $(grep -m1 'LAYERS_NOW=' push.txt)"

AWS_PROFILE=deploy-admin python3 -u - <<'PY' > verify.txt 2>&1
import gzip, io, json, tarfile, urllib.request
import boto3
REPO = "eyecloud-fargate-runner"
ecr = boto3.client("ecr", region_name="us-east-1")

def load(tag):
    m = json.loads(ecr.batch_get_image(repositoryName=REPO, imageIds=[{"imageTag": tag}])["images"][0]["imageManifest"])
    if "manifests" in m:
        e = next(x for x in m["manifests"] if x.get("platform", {}).get("architecture") in ("amd64", "x86_64"))
        m = json.loads(ecr.batch_get_image(repositoryName=REPO, imageIds=[{"imageDigest": e["digest"]}])["images"][0]["imageManifest"])
    return m

base, new = load("mott-lane-35"), load("mott-lane-36")
assert [l["digest"] for l in new["layers"]][:len(base["layers"])] == [l["digest"] for l in base["layers"]], "base layers were altered"
assert len(new["layers"]) == len(base["layers"]) + 1, "expected exactly one appended layer"
print("BASE_LAYERS_UNCHANGED=1 APPENDED=1")
last = new["layers"][-1]
url = ecr.get_download_url_for_layer(repositoryName=REPO, layerDigest=last["digest"])["downloadUrl"]
blob = urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=300).read()
tf = tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(gzip.decompress(blob)))
names = tf.getnames()
assert names == ["opt/cvc-booking-gateway/bland_gateway.py"], "overlay layer contains unexpected members: %r" % names
got = tf.extractfile(names[0]).read()
want = open("/home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGWfix4/gw-correction-offer-relative/bland_gateway_fixed.py", "rb").read()
assert got == want, "pushed gateway file does not byte-match the proven artifact"
print("VERIFY_IDENTICAL=1 bytes=%d" % len(got))
print("VERIFY_DONE")
PY
rc=$?; diff -u /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGWfix2/gw-prod-extract2/bland_gateway_prod.py /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGWfix4/gw-correction-offer-relative/bland_gateway_fixed.py > full_delta.diff; echo "FULL_DELTA_LINES=$(grep -c '^[+-]' full_delta.diff)" >> verify.txt; cat verify.txt; exit $rc
tasks.check: grep -q 'VERIFY_DONE' verify.txt || { echo 'FAIL: verification did not finish:'; tail -6 verify.txt; exit 1; }; grep -q 'BASE_LAYERS_UNCHANGED=1' verify.txt || { echo 'FAIL: base layers altered'; exit 1; }; grep -q 'VERIFY_IDENTICAL=1' verify.txt || { echo 'FAIL: pushed file does not match the proven artifact'; exit 1; }; echo "PASS: pushed image byte-verified - $(grep -m1 'VERIFY_IDENTICAL=1' verify.txt); $(grep -m1 'FULL_DELTA_LINES=' verify.txt)"
tasks.verified: The pushed mott-lane-36 re-downloaded and proven: all base layers digest-identical, exactly one overlay layer containing only the gateway file, byte-identical to the proof-passing artifact; full production delta recorded.

AWS_PROFILE=deploy-admin python3 -u - <<'PY' > deploy.txt 2>&1
import boto3
ecs = boto3.client("ecs", region_name="us-east-1")
td = ecs.describe_task_definition(taskDefinition="mott-booking-gateway:50")["taskDefinition"]
for k in ("taskDefinitionArn", "revision", "status", "requiresAttributes", "compatibilities", "registeredAt", "registeredBy", "deregisteredAt"):
    td.pop(k, None)
img = td["containerDefinitions"][0]["image"]
assert img.endswith(":mott-lane-35"), "rev 50 image unexpectedly %s" % img
td["containerDefinitions"][0]["image"] = img.replace(":mott-lane-35", ":mott-lane-36")
new = ecs.register_task_definition(**td)["taskDefinition"]
rev = new["revision"]
print("NEW_REVISION=%d IMAGE=%s" % (rev, new["containerDefinitions"][0]["image"].rsplit(":", 1)[-1]))
ecs.update_service(cluster="stack2", service="mott-booking-gateway", taskDefinition="mott-booking-gateway:%d" % rev)
print("SERVICE_UPDATE_ISSUED=1")
waiter = ecs.get_waiter("services_stable")
waiter.wait(cluster="stack2", services=["mott-booking-gateway"], WaiterConfig={"Delay": 15, "MaxAttempts": 60})
svc = ecs.describe_services(cluster="stack2", services=["mott-booking-gateway"])["services"][0]
print("STABLE taskdef=%s running=%d desired=%d" % (svc["taskDefinition"].rsplit("/", 1)[-1], svc["runningCount"], svc["desiredCount"]))
print("ROLLBACK_CMD=aws ecs update-service --cluster stack2 --service mott-booking-gateway --task-definition mott-booking-gateway:50")
print("DEPLOY_DONE")
PY
rc=$?; cat deploy.txt; exit $rc
tasks.check: grep -q 'DEPLOY_DONE' deploy.txt || { echo 'FAIL: deploy did not reach stable:'; tail -8 deploy.txt; exit 1; }; grep -qE 'STABLE taskdef=mott-booking-gateway:[0-9]+ running=[1-9]' deploy.txt || { echo 'FAIL: service not stable on new revision'; exit 1; }; r=$(grep -oE 'NEW_REVISION=[0-9]+' deploy.txt | cut -d= -f2); grep -q "taskdef=mott-booking-gateway:$r " deploy.txt || { echo "FAIL: service stable on a different revision than registered ($r)"; exit 1; }; echo "PASS: $(grep -m1 'STABLE' deploy.txt); rollback on record"
tasks.verified: A new task-definition revision cloned from rev 50 (CPU upgrade preserved) with only the image tag changed to the byte-verified mott-lane-36, service updated on stack2 and waited to stable, rollback command printed.
